name: Michelle Chalfant
reason: Strict health rule: her own site sells her brand on conditions. The author bio on her free-guide page credits her podcast with helping listeners 'conquer anxiety, depression, and codependency' (and her own 'love addiction'), her book page markets The Adult Chair to people who have 'struggled with anxiety, codependency' (Amazon's blurb adds healing 'generational trauma'), her store sells a codependency masterclass, and her Insight Timer tracks include codependency and anxiety titles, so a listing would send people to condition-led pages, as with Christian Thomas and Camilla Sacre-Dallerup. Judgement call: she would otherwise qualify (licensed therapist and coach, YouTube 75.5K + Instagram 21K + Facebook 29.1K + Insight Timer 32k = about 158k, luminary; published email michelle@michellechalfant.com; strong inner-child and energy meditations on YouTube). Her course checkout pages are also behind a Cloudflare bot check.
